objective.description: Open Magistr before choosing a project or starting an agent, then prepare and open directories in the same window.
acceptance_criteria: A native launch with no directory argument, no prepared project or an unavailable provider opens a usable project chooser with recoverable guidance; no provider is launched just to display it.
A native folder selection or explicit path opens a prepared project, or previews the real per-path setup plan with ownership/refusal details and applies that exact plan.
Partial, declined or refused setup stays visible and does not admit a fake project. After success, the same window opens a session through the existing authority.

Recent projects use current history/configuration owners. Update canonical setup metadata, docs and generated guidance for the Rust desktop and retained CLI/MCP roles; preserve project identity and user customizations.
Real-window tests cover clean launch, existing/new/invalid directories, unavailable provider, declined and partial setup, last-session close and later reopening using isolated state.

Before implementation, verify each behavior's producer, owning service and reader in current code. Fix missing behavior in its owner and update current callers together; add no parallel store or compatibility path. Use focused verification with formatting, affected crate/interface checks, real behavior tests and applicable native accessibility, contrast, icon, screenshot and architecture checks. Do not export roadmap files or widen to unrelated full suites.
constraints: Preserve the pre-existing guard hook change; commit only this iteration's work.
One lazy application session authority; use existing administrative setup and history owners.
No compatibility paths or roadmap exports.
Focused affected crate, setup, native-window, contrast/icon/screenshot and architecture checks.
